description:
Synthetic positional command covering every flag type; test scaffolding only.
Output: one finding per line (logfmt; format=json for JSON), terminated by the mandatory summary line scanned=<n> findings=<n> elapsed=<d> — findings=0 with a summary present means scanned-and-healthy; a result without a summary line is void.
Fields beyond the shared envelope (kind, severity, namespace, kind_of_object, name, reason, message, fingerprint): target — the positional argument as received; grace — the parsed --grace value.

format.description: output format: logfmt|json (one record per line either way)

namespace.description: limit the scan to one namespace

since.description: how far back to look (0 = command default) (Go duration, e.g. "90s", "5m")

target.description: <Kind>/[<namespace>/]<name> — the one resource to read; namespace defaults to --namespace

timeout.description: abort the invocation after this long (exit 1) (Go duration, e.g. "90s", "5m")

workload.description: target one workload as <Kind>/<namespace>/<name>, e.g. Deployment/prod/api

description:

Fields beyond the shared envelope (kind, severity, namespace, kind_of_object, name, reason, message, fingerprint): index — 1-based ordinal of the synthetic finding.

count.description: number of synthetic findings to emit

fail.description: return a runtime error after emitting
